prompt.text:
Implement `compareCatalogs(referenceEntries, candidateEntries, done)`. Export an object containing exactly this function with `module.exports`.

Each catalog is an array of records shaped as `{ name, body }`, where `name` is a non-empty string and `body` is a string. Names must be unique within each catalog. The catalogs match only when they contain the same names and every corresponding body is exactly equal; array order is irrelevant. Extra or missing entries make the result `false`.

`done` must be a function; otherwise throw `TypeError` synchronously. All other validation and comparison work must complete asynchronously. Call `done(error)` for malformed catalogs or duplicate names, and `done(null, result)` otherwise. Invoke it exactly once and do not mutate either array or its records. Empty catalogs match each other.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
